items.title: Arthur Davis and Andy Mosley Interview, 1960-01-12
items.q: Well that's Phil, practically Phil work there.

ctx.x: Let's get your name down now, Arthur Davis. Arthur Davis? Yes sir. And you sing on this record, huh? Yes sir. And you're? And the Muslim. Mm-hmm. And you've got your lovers coming up too. So I thought we'd record a little bit of your impressions about it, and you can tell me about what the song means. Yes sir. What do you do? No, just let it go. What do you do when you sing this song? We'll all be in a group and sing a song, and practically after we get to the center, we'll rehearse on another one. But I mean,…
Okay. I think you own this one.
